name: Kashmir, Together
description: A proposed women-only journey with comfortable stays and a sociable pace.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Srinagar
itinerary.description: Meet your arranged transfer and settle into your stay. Keep the day flexible around arrival and rest.

itinerary.title: Gardens, old lanes & lake light
itinerary.description: Explore a selection of Srinagar gardens and the lakefront. A shared shikara session and specified garden entry are part of the proposed plan.

itinerary.title: A mountain day in Gulmarg
itinerary.description: Travel to Gulmarg for time in the mountain landscape. Gondola tickets and specialist snow activities are separately priced unless confirmed in your quote.

itinerary.title: Follow the Lidder
itinerary.description: Continue towards Pahalgam and check in. Leave space for riverside time and an easy evening.

itinerary.title: Meadows at your pace
itinerary.description: Choose from suitable local sightseeing or time to unwind. Any local union transport must be itemised before confirmation.

itinerary.title: Until next time
itinerary.description: Check out and take the arranged transfer for your onward journey. Departure timings and road buffers will be confirmed in your proposal.
